candidates.name: Clint Export Project (Oasis Pipeline Waha to Clint extension)
aka: Oasis Pipe Line Co. Texas extension
candidates.sponsor: Oasis Pipeline LP / Oasis Pipe Line Company Texas LP (Energy Transfer)
candidates.to: Clint, El Paso County, TX (border crossing to Tarahumara Pipeline, Chihuahua)

evidence.note: NGI item on FERC approval of Section 3 authorization and presidential permit for Oasis border facilities near Clint; about 600 MMcf/d, about 188 miles of 36-inch pipe from Waha (page date not confirmed; same project described in secondary search summaries).

candidates.why_maybe_new: Borderline: roster has P0234 Oasis Gas Pipeline (operating, 966 km, whole system) and P4453 Oasis modernization, but no row for the 188 mile 36-inch Waha-Clint extension. Possibly never built (Comanche Trail P2519 Waha-San Elizario covers a similar corridor); build status unknown. Length about 303 km.
